title: Static image governance scanned ignored control-plane source overlays

reproduction.error: Local image asset is missing an explicit source/license note for out/control-plane-v5/source-overlays/<context>/performance/thumbnail.png.
reproduction.failed_after: control-plane, release-controller, shadow-contract, workflow, documentation, architecture, settings, and legacy-inventory checks passed

root_cause.summary: The image-license check recursively enumerated the physical repository directory instead of Git-governed tracked and non-ignored untracked files. Context-addressed source overlays are intentionally ignored execution staging, so copied package assets were incorrectly reclassified as new repository assets.

regression_propositions: repository asset validation enumerates git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard
ignored control-plane overlays cannot create false asset-governance failures
tracked and non-ignored untracked image assets still require explicit source and license records
complete static validation passes while context-addressed source overlays exist

closure.proof_required: complete static validation with populated context-addressed source overlays
